pump_enabled.description: Enable pump mode for distcc. If disabled, distcc falls back to standard (non-pump) distributed compilation.

pump_dir.description: Directory where pump mode stores session state and cached files. Must be writable by the distccd user.

pump_max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent pump mode sessions. Higher values allow more parallel jobs but increase resource usage.

pump_hosts.description: List of hosts to include in the pump cluster. Each host should be in 'hostname' or 'hostname:port' format. If empty, only local compilation is used.

pump_startup_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a pump session to start before timing out.

pump_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for pump mode internals. Helpful for debugging.

pump_log.description: Path to a dedicated pump log file. If empty, logs go to syslog instead.

pump_compress.description: Enable compression of files transferred during pump sessions. Reduces network usage at the cost of CPU.
